name: com.scangoal/mcp
title: ScanGoal
description: Football stats and money flow on Polymarket, Kalshi, Betfair: top load, trend, team strength

tools.name: top_money_load_today
tools.description: The single biggest money load (amount traded on one outcome) today on prediction markets and betting exchanges (Polymarket, Kalshi, Betfair): match, market, outcome, USD volume, link. One row only.

sport.description: Optional sport filter: football, basketball, hockey, tennis, american_football, cs2, dota2, table_tennis, volleyball.

lang.description: Language of labels and links (scangoal.com / scangoal.ru). Default en.

tools.name: trend_of_day
tools.description: The strongest goal trend among today's upcoming football matches: both teams' last 10 games (Over 2.5, Under 2.5 or both teams to score), e.g. 9/10 and 8/10. One match only.

lang.description: Language of labels and links (scangoal.com / scangoal.ru). Default en.

tools.name: match_strength
tools.description: ScanGoal Strength of both teams (10 = even, higher = stronger) and last-10 form for the nearest football match of a team (today or next 36 h).

team.description: Team name (English), e.g. Arsenal, Real Madrid.

lang.description: Language of labels and links (scangoal.com / scangoal.ru). Default en.

tools.name: match_of_day
tools.description: Short card of today's football match with the most money traded on exchanges: strength, form, last-10 summary, head-to-head, link.

lang.description: Language of labels and links (scangoal.com / scangoal.ru). Default en.

tools.name: glossary_term
tools.description: Short definition of a betting or football-stats term from the ScanGoal glossary (xG, BTTS, Asian handicap, CLV, money load / progruz, Polymarket, Kalshi, betting exchange...) with a link.

term.description: Term or slug, e.g. xg, btts, asian-handicap, progruz.

lang.description: Language of labels and links (scangoal.com / scangoal.ru). Default en.
